title: Set a repo-local, already-public Git identity on runner data clones before any engram-data commit
outcome: Set a repo-local, already-public Git identity on runner data clones before any engram-data commit
acceptance: Runner hosts (DL560, Mac) that commit engram-data use a data clone whose repo-local user.name/user.email equal an identity already public in that repository, so a data commit never publishes a new personal email
The engram-use skill's disclosure check names commit author and committer metadata among the things to read before a push
